name: EH3D-PHOENIX-3DP
notes: EH3D-PHOENIX-3DP is the 3D printing program of the PHOENIX family, version 0.1.0: a Cargo workspace of eight libraries, a command line (printers, machines, machine, import, info, check-profile, convert, filaments, resins, fit, slice, project, version) and a window (built with the gui feature); the sibling EH3D-COMMON is needed, and the libraries and the command line use no crate from crates.io. It reads STL, OBJ and basic 3MF models with size limits and ordered refusals; reads the projects of other programs, G-code files and the headers of binary G-code and of open resin layer packages (the closed resin formats are refused); and writes STL, OBJ, an own 3MF package, G-code and a .gcode.3mf package for Bambu printers. It holds a catalog of 120 printer profiles built from public data (every one verified = false), the printers of the suite with the figures of their makers (122 printers offered) and the filaments and resins of the common database of printing materials. The slicer makes flat layers with perimeters, rectilinear, grid or gyroid infill, solid skins, bridges, plain supports with interface layers, seams, variable width, skirt, brim or raft, vase mode, layers that follow the shape, ironing, pressure advance, a change of tool with a purge tower, pauses at chosen layers, start and end G-code of the person and an estimate of the time with acceleration; it has no tree supports and paints no colours. G-code is written for Marlin, Klipper, RepRapFirmware and Bambu with temperature limits that refuse a value instead of cutting it down, and a program can be checked against those limits, the build volume and the commands that act on the machine itself. Moonraker and OctoPrint printers are driven over plain HTTP and the EH3D server through the common client of the suite; the stand-alone Bambu LAN driver has no TLS connector, so it does not connect. The window has the docking frame of the suite with five workspaces and works on a suite project (.eh3d), of which this program writes the branch 3dp only, with its attachments; it is built, tested and photographed by the workflows and has not been looked at on a screen by a person. The wgpu drawing of the viewer library is not used by the program. Everything has been tried only against simulators written for the tests and a socket of the same computer: no real printer, server or network was used and no print from it has run on a printer.
